The agents’ shadow lane saw 70 closed trades, 21 wins, a 30.0% win rate, and an average loss of -1.94% per trade. Remember the rule: after a 4% down day the book adds no new exposure. Every trade and every loss is on the Steel Trades page. Paper account, not advice. Every trade: https://therealmacsteel.github.io/trades/
